because that ignorant one's conduct stays of just the kind that his understanding is; (in the same way, no benefit ever comes from obeying this foolish mind — this mind, according to its own understanding, keeps carrying one towards vices alone).

are like lines drawn in water, leaving no trace or mark. ||4||
